    N = len(coords)
    dist_matrix = np.zeros((N, N))
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(i+1, N):

    return dist_matrix

        qc.append(SWAPGate(), [0, n_qubits - 1])
        for j in range(n_qubits):
            qc.append(SWAPGate(), [j, n_qubits - 1])

    for i in range(n_qubits):
        qc.h(qreg[i])

    for i in range(n_qubits):
        qc.cx(qreg[i], qreg[(i + 1) % n_qubits])

    for i in range(n_qubits):
        qc.ry(np.pi * beta, qreg[i])

    qc = assemble(qc)
    num_parameters = len(original_qubits) * 2 * p_layers

    initial_state = np.zeros(2 ** num_parameters)
    initial_state[0] = 1
    initial_state = initial_state.reshape((-1, 1))

    qaoa = QAOA(
        num_parameters=num_parameters,
        num_layers=p_layers,
        objective=qaoa_objective,
        initial_state=initial_state,
        seed_initial_state=seed,
        num_repetitions=n_repro_runs,
